body:
Nominates Lady Arandiel while invoking Aria’s example of courage.

Recorded role and choices

At the 1 December 2025 gathering, Liraeth appears in armor and announces the Radiant Dawn’s nomination of Lady Arandiel. Her claim that Arandiel has the courage to lead as Aria did is a political judgment made by Liraeth. Neither the nomination’s success nor a wider biography is supplied by the single checked intervention.
